target: FinnGen HFRS GWAS and UK Biobank replication
current_evidence: Nature Aging reports the custom continuous 109-weighted-ICD-10-code HFRS GWAS in FinnGen R12 (N=500,737), with UKB replication (N=407,463), 53 lead variants, and a general FinnGen results route. Publisher supplementary workbook archived and checksummed: ST1 has 1,588 nonempty rows for FinnGen HFRS hits at P<5e-8 and ST2 has 492 corresponding no-dementia rows; both provide UKB/METAL results. These are thresholded reported-hit tables, not complete genome-wide summary statistics or a verified custom R12 endpoint file. The prior FinnGen access-page check calls the 2026-06-02 release DF13, while the current official release handbook lists DF14/R13 and expected Q2 2026 results; endpoint totals also differ. A 2026-09-24 streaming scan of the official public R12 manifest found 2,469 listed records and zero HFRS/frailty label matches (audit: analysis/hfrs_r12_public_manifest_recheck_2026-09-24.md); this checks manifest labels only and does not exclude separately delivered or opaque-named custom results. FinnGen documents its standard R12 core pipeline as 2,502 endpoints/500,348 samples using Regenie, whereas the HFRS paper describes a custom SAIGE analysis at N=500,737; do not treat standard endpoints as equivalent. Bulk summary downloads still route through the online form and emailed instructions. See review/targeted_resource_audit.md, analysis/hfrs_published_supplement_audit_2026-09-24.md and analysis/hfrs_finngen_release_route_recheck_2026-09-24_1505.md. 2026-09-26 recheck: FinnGen Access Results reports DF13 public release on 2026-06-02, 2,755 endpoints and the R13 browser; bulk summary download still requires an official access form followed by emailed instructions. The clinical-endpoints page links a DF13 definition workbook while listing DF14 as current definitions. A direct request for the linked DF13 workbook returned HTTP 406 in this environment; it was not acquired, and this does not establish absence. These release-wide sources still do not identify the article-specific HFRS endpoint or exact summary-statistics files (see analysis/hfrs_public_route_recheck_2026-09-26.md). 2026-09-28 read-only primary-source check: the article data-availability statement points to FinnGen's generic access page but does not identify a custom HFRS file; the official page states DF13 (public release 2026-06-02; 2,755 endpoints; 500,186 participants) and requires an online form followed by emailed download instructions. No form submitted and no file downloaded; see analysis/hfrs_official_access_recheck_2026-09-28.md.
overlap_or_scope: UKB replication may overlap with project sleep/frailty sources; Finnish discovery may be more independent but requires exact source, ancestry, model, build and sample-overlap review
next_action: Use the archived hit tables only for qualified reported-locus cross-reference after source/build/allele checks. Obtain full HFRS and HFRS-without-dementia statistics only through the official form/email route or exact source documentation; verify endpoint identity, release, sample, model, build, scale, overlap, checksum and terms. Do not substitute a standard DF13/DF14 endpoint or release for the custom R12 score without endpoint-equivalence evidence.

target: Seven latent frailty factor GWAS plus pneumonia GWAS
current_evidence: All eight Catalog TSVs and metadata YAMLs acquired; each TSV/YAML MD5 matches its accession md5sum.txt. YAML explicitly maps 046 general frailty, 047–052 factors 1–6 (050 metabolic problems; 052 disability), and 053 pneumonia. All are GRCh37/European. Basic stream/header scan passes all eight; seven factor files have zero basic numeric anomalies, while pneumonia has 466,894 rows with missing/non-finite beta or SE. Exact per-accession N is in latent_frailty_accession_index.tsv.
overlap_or_scope: Seven mapped factor GWAS are candidate secondary analyses; participant overlap/cohort composition with sleep and other frailty GWAS still requires primary-study reconciliation. Pneumonia is not a latent frailty factor and has unresolved numeric anomalies.
next_action: Perform duplicate-variant, allele, source-model, sample-overlap and harmonization QC for the seven factor GWAS; review pneumonia anomalies without filtering or using it as a factor.

target: Human skeletal muscle cell atlas with age/fitness/frailty phenotype
current_evidence: Nature article and live official HLMA portal verified. 31 hindlimb-biopsy participants; QC multimodal set 22 individuals and 387,444 profiles: 212,774 snRNA nuclei, 79,649 scRNA cells, 95,021 snATAC nuclei. Barthel/Charlson function/comorbidity indices; 15 sc/snRNA and 11 snATAC main populations. Portal lists 10 snRNA count matrices, 6 snATAC peak matrices, 1 scRNA count archive, 6 sc/snRNA H5ADs and 46 snATAC fragment entries; targetable 23-object inventory with displayed sizes is in frailty_paper/manifests/hlma_processed_file_inventory.tsv. Project-level CNP accessions: CNP0004394; CNP0004395; CNP0004494; CNP0004495. Per-file mapping, checksums, dataset-specific object terms and snATAC peak build remain unresolved.
overlap_or_scope: Functional cell context and regulatory annotations only; not independent genetic evidence or replication. Small surgery-derived mixed-country cohort; participant-level frailty measures and modality-specific overlap require supplement/object metadata.
next_action: Only after a qualifying frozen project locus exists, select relevant cell-type object(s); capture exact direct URL, CNP mapping, checksum, object metadata/build and applicable terms, then query that bounded subset. Do not infer build or download bulk objects now.

current_evidence: 17 adult intercostal donors (8 young aged 20-40; 9 aged 60-75); 90902 cells and 92259 nuclei from droplet 3-prime scRNA-seq/snRNA-seq; 40 major human populations; seven processed human H5AD objects indexed in `frailty_paper/manifests/muscle_single_cell_resource_index.tsv`; raw new libraries at ArrayExpress E-MTAB-13874
overlap_or_scope: No frailty measure identified; most donors underwent CPAP or mechanical ventilation during hospital stay; not a frailty case-control GWAS
next_action: Use processed objects only for post-gate cell context, accounting for hospital/ventilation caveat; no raw FASTQ download absent a justified need

target: UKB-PPP Olink and deCODE Icelandic SomaScan pQTL resources
current_evidence: UKB-PPP: 54,219 profiled; pQTL analysis strata 46,218 British/Irish, 1,513 African, 953 South Asian; 2,923 proteins/2,931 assays, 14,287 primary pQTLs. deCODE: 35,892 Icelandic participants, 4,907 SomaScan assays; both have published pQTL summary statistics. See `frailty_paper/manifests/pqtl_resource_index.tsv` for access routes and file-level uncertainty
overlap_or_scope: UKB overlap with UKB sleep/frailty likely; Icelandic cohort may overlap Icelandic aging GWAS; assay and protein measurement differ across Olink/SomaScan; require per-file build, N, scale, ancestry and license
next_action: After valid loci, query matched protein assay/locus only; inspect file metadata and explicit access terms before download; do not bulk-download the 19.7-TB deCODE release or assume AWS/Synapse access based on catalog labels

current_evidence: FinnGen access page (public release 2026-08-13) reports 1,108 donors, 10,612,211 snRNA and 7,100,899 snATAC nuclei, 33 cell types, 27,294 genes and 297,024 chromatin peaks analyzed, and 17,167,198 variants. Current CASCADE browser search-index metadata identifies v1.0.0/R12 and describes an L0 PBMC + 8 L1 + 24 L2 hierarchy; it reports 20,829 cis-eGenes, 210,584 cis-caPeaks, 119,094 fine-mapped molQTL variants (PIP>0.5), and 593,765 peak-gene links (104,780 peaks × 12,018 genes). The 2025 preprint reports 20,829 genes, 210,584 peaks, 119,094 fine-mapped variants, and 496,488 enhancer-gene links. Thus the gene/peak difference is explained by release-page analyzed-feature counts versus cis-QTL target counts; the 593,765 vs 496,488 link totals remain an unresolved browser-versus-preprint version/definition discrepancy. Public browser access is available; bulk summaries require FinnGen’s access form and emailed download instructions. No files acquired because there are no eligible project loci.
overlap_or_scope: Finnish donor resource; distinct from HFRS GWAS summary data; functional QTL context is not independent replication and requires eligible loci
next_action: After eligible loci exist, use the public browser for targeted lookup. If underlying bulk summaries are needed, use the official form/email route; do not treat access-page feature counts, browser cis-QTL target counts, or preprint/current-browser link totals as equivalent. See analysis/finngen_cascade_release_metadata_recheck_2026-09-25.md; no bulk acquisition.

target: BrainSCOPE human DLPFC cell-type expression and QTL resources
current_evidence: Official resource pages describe 388 adult DLPFC samples; 388-row PEC2 sample metadata is checksum-registered with both link indexes in all_acquired_resources.tsv. Metadata spans 12 cohorts and reports EUR/AFR/AMR/EAS/SAS ancestry; no expression matrices or QTL statistics acquired
overlap_or_scope: Brain cell-context annotation is not independent frailty genetic evidence; sample metadata does not supply sleep/frailty phenotypes; confirm loci, cell type, study ancestry/build and resource-specific terms before any targeted lookup
next_action: After eligible loci are frozen, assess whether a cell-type/locus-matched lookup adds evidence; do not download full archives preemptively

current_evidence: Open Zenodo record and all five component files acquired and size/MD5 verified. Deposit README says Regenie v3.5 and UK Biobank but gives no build, detailed ancestry/QC, effect scale/model, or generating-study provenance. README citation points to a 2025 heart-failure study of 49,530 UKB participants; the five component files report N=396,819–406,980, and that paper says the physical-frailty GWAS came from a prior study. The citation therefore does not establish provenance for these files.
overlap_or_scope: UK Biobank membership confirmed at source-record level; exact cross-GWAS participant overlap and source of GWAS estimates remain unresolved.
next_action: Request a release-specific technical statement from the depositor covering source study/cohorts, genome build, ancestry, variant QC, effect scale/model, covariates, sample overlap, and whether the 2025 cited paper generated or only used these files. Do not harmonize before resolution.

target: 2026 human vastus-lateralis snRNA-seq aging study with functional measures
current_evidence: Publisher article reports eight Chinese male donors (5 aged 22–60; 3 aged 99–101), SPPB, DXA skeletal muscle index, grip strength and walking pace; 80,277 captured and 71,373 post-QC nuclei; GRCh38/Ensembl 105; author data statement cites NGDC GSA-Human HRA009010 and says raw data were made public. The article does not identify a processed matrix location. Direct accession-level access and file contents were not verified. General NGDC documentation describes GSA-Human as controlled-access human data.
overlap_or_scope: Eight male donors and an extreme age contrast; measured physical function does not make this a validated frailty phenotype. Not genetic replication; no sleep phenotype, GWAS or QTL.
next_action: If eligible loci arise and a cell-context query is justified, verify HRA009010 access and available processed files directly through NGDC; use only authorized access. Do not download raw reads solely to create an atlas while upstream locus gates fail.

target: Open human skeletal-muscle aging snRNA/snATAC multiome processed matrices
current_evidence: Official GEO MINiML crosswalk covers all 20 sample records: five Young and five Aged biological replicates, each with GEX and ATAC records; all 20 list Assembly hg38 and Cell Ranger ARC v2.0.1 processing. GEO sample metadata gives hamstring muscle and broad muscle mononuclear cell labels, but no per-sample exact age or sex. The primary article reports 12 clusters (MuSCs; FAP1/FAP2; EC1–EC3; pericytes; SMC1/SMC2; macrophages; B/T/NK; a small number of mature skeletal muscle nuclei); these are article-level labels, not verified barcode annotations. Crosswalk and checksums: frailty_paper/manifests/muscle_gse268953_sn_multiome_sample_crosswalk.tsv and manifests/source_metadata/GSE268953/.
overlap_or_scope: Age-only male cohort with surgery-indication confounding; no validated frailty phenotype, no genetic replication/QTL, cell-level labels not confirmed in downloadable matrices.
next_action: After an eligible frozen project locus exists, inspect only the required matrix/barcode subset, exact reuse terms, and any cell annotation-to-barcode map. Do not retrieve the 1.9 GB full matrices or raw FASTQs before locus eligibility.

target: Open processed human skeletal-muscle aging/frailty single-nucleus RNA-seq
current_evidence: Official GEO MINiML and simplified sheet map all 17 snRNA GSMs to donor labels, ages and listed matrix filenames; six young donors are 19–22 y and 11 old donors 70–90 y, matching the primary article. GEO sample attributes do not list sex or clinical frailty/sarcopenia status. Source snapshots and donor-level crosswalk are preserved under manifests/source_metadata/GSE167186 and manifests/muscle_gse167186_snRNA_donor_crosswalk.tsv. GEO age for OldHM23 is 90, exceeding the article’s stated 65–85 recruitment band; retained as source-reported pending reconciliation. The primary paper reports 143,051 nuclei transcriptomes after its QC/preprocessing/alignment (93,406 old; 49,645 young) and seven broad clusters: type I/II fibers, FAPs, satellite, smooth muscle, endothelial and immune cells. Downloadable barcode-to-cell annotation mapping remains unverified; later reanalyses retain different counts after their own QC.
overlap_or_scope: Contextual cell expression only, not independent genetic evidence. Age-only snRNA comparison; do not transfer parent bulk-cohort sarcopenia labels.
next_action: Before age-restricted interpretation, reconcile OldHM23/GSM5098753 GEO age 90 vs primary-paper recruitment band 65–85; verify whether sex or clinical measures are available elsewhere through official sample-level sources. For later locus-specific use, verify cell annotations and lawful reuse. No raw FASTQ download.

target: Processed single-cell reference atlas of adult human muscle
current_evidence: Official GEO lists 10 adult donor samples and processed cell/sample metadata (429.3 KB), normalized expression (2.1 GB), and raw counts (38 MB). Multi-site reference atlas; no frailty phenotype. Direct processing and sample-level age/cell-label crosswalk not audited.
overlap_or_scope: Cell reference only; diverse anatomical sites, not an aging contrast or independent GWAS/QTL replication.
next_action: Use only if an eligible locus/gene and tissue hypothesis exist; inspect donor metadata and annotation map before any query. Avoid full 2.1 GB normalized download until justified.
